parsed.rationale: Two of the four participating records are located in 'Shared/Artwork/Tests/ArtworkTests/ArtworkServiceTests.swift' with package 'Artwork', which is a test file. Per the decision rules, any cluster containing a record with is_test=true (or residing under a Tests/ path) must be treated as a test fixture and no refactoring action should be taken. Lifting the CGImage extensions from the test file into shared production code would couple production semantics to test-only helpers. The two Image extensions in 'Shared/Core/Sources/Core/Models and Services/ImageCompatability.swift' may warrant consolidation on their own, but the mixed nature of this cluster — production and test records together — means the cluster as a whole warrants no action.
